descriptionInUI: Runs the 'Host tool: F10 red-interceptor scramble menu' setting. The F10 'HOST: Red Scramble' menu launches a 2- or 4-ship of red fighters from a red airfield and keeps vectoring it onto the nearest blue fighters. The bandits are not tracked by the campaign.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Host player names (comma-separated; empty = every BLUE player)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Matches any part of the DCS name, so a tag like 'Flash' covers 'Viper 1-1 | Flash'.
air = overhead at once, hot = on the ramp, runway = on the runway.
